name: XLA_ANALYTICAL_HDRS_B_
description: This table contains the header information for the analytical criteria. Since some analytical criteria are delivered as seeded data by the product teams, the name and the description are subjected to translation, so there are two tables for the analytical criteria.

columns.name: SUPPORTING_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Supporting reference unique identifier.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting methods builder context.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_CODE
columns.description: Supporting reference short name.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description:
An abbreviated name that indicates the owner of a supporting reference. Possible values are
C: defined by the user, S: predefined by Oracle.

columns.name: SUPP_REF_ORDER
columns.description: Order of the supporting reference

columns.name: BALANCING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether balance will be maintained for the specific supporting reference

columns.name: DISPLAY_ORDER
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the supporting reference is enabled.

columns.name: YEAR_END_CARRY_FORWARD_CODE
columns.description: If the BALANCING_FLAG = Y it must have one of the following values, otherwise it must be null. A: The supporting reference balances are always carried forward to the next fiscal year. N: The supporting reference balances are never carried forward to the next fiscal year. B: The supporting reference balances are conditionally carried forward to the next fiscal year, depending on the account type.

columns.name: UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate if the application accounting definition is updated since last exported

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number generated automatically at the time of export

columns.name: UPDATED_IN_ESSBASE
columns.description: Indicates If the specific dimension is created for the supporting reference in ESSBASE.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
